lines.zh: 我迈着沉重的腿在林中走
lines.en: I walk through the woods on heavy legs.
My carapace is blue and bright.

lines.zh: 我的角向前伸，走起来一顿一顿
lines.en: My horn points forward; my walk jolts.

lines.zh: 三米不到的身高，树都得让
lines.en: Not quite three meters tall; the trees give way.

lines.zh: 我的壳上有细密的纹路
lines.en: Fine patterns cover my shell.

lines.zh: 我一步一步踩实，地面有声
lines.en: I plant each step, and the ground answers.

lines.zh: 我踩过空地，落叶全翻起来
lines.en: I cross the clearing and the leaves turn over.

lines.zh: 我的影子盖住一整片地
lines.en: My shadow covers a whole patch of ground.

lines.zh: 我的四条腿很粗，走不快
lines.en: My four legs are thick; I do not go fast.

lines.zh: 我绕开小树，不想弄倒它
lines.en: I step around saplings rather than flatten them.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀收在壳下，只露出边
lines.en: My wings stay under the shell, only the edges showing.
I walk toward wherever the insects are.

lines.zh: 我站着，像一尊蓝甲的像
lines.en: I stand like a statue in blue armor.

lines.zh: 我的甲壳在光照下有反光
lines.en: My carapace catches the light.
I listen for insects in the wood.
Old scrapes mark my horn.

lines.zh: 我不需要吃很多，只吃虫
lines.en: I do not need much; only insects.

lines.zh: 我在锚点附近转，不会走远
lines.en: I keep near my anchor and wander little.

lines.zh: 我的口器很小，和身体不符
lines.en: My mouthparts are small for my size.

lines.zh: 这一片林子是我的范围
lines.en: This stand of trees is my range.
I look up at the light in the canopy.
My legs ache a little.
I wait for something to fall.

lines.zh: 我的甲壳上有一层薄灰
lines.en: A thin film of dust coats my shell.
I do not cry out; my voice is low.

lines.zh: 我换个方向，甲片互相磨
lines.en: I turn, and my plates grind together.

lines.zh: 我从树影里把角抬出来
lines.en: I lift my horn out of the tree shade.
You are shorter, but I do not dismiss you.

lines.zh: 我的复眼把你的影子拆成很多块
lines.en: My compound eyes split your shape into many pieces.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，树被我撞响
lines.en: I step back, and the tree rings.
Don't close in from both sides.

lines.zh: 你的手抬起来，我就压低
lines.en: Your hand lifts, and I lower myself.
This is my anchor.

lines.zh: 我分辨你手里拿的是什么
lines.en: I'm making out what's in your hand.

lines.zh: 我的甲壳很硬，你不用试
lines.en: My shell is hard; do not bother testing it.
If you do not move, neither do I.
I open my wings slightly.

lines.zh: 我们之间隔着一棵倒木
lines.en: A fallen log lies between us.
You smell of insects.
I lower my horn and wait for you to speak.

lines.zh: 你的味道我标在锚点边上
lines.en: I mark your scent beside my anchor.

lines.zh: 我不是好斗的，但我会打
lines.en: I am not aggressive, but I can fight.
I give a step, shell rattling.

lines.zh: 这一下在我壳上留了痕
lines.en: That left a mark on my shell.

lines.zh: 我没有出声，只把角放低
lines.en: I made no sound; I only lowered my horn.

lines.zh: 甲壳上的纹路抖了一下
lines.en: The ridges on my shell shiver.
I turn in place.
A numbness runs through my wing base.

lines.zh: 这一下打断了我的蓄力
lines.en: That broke my charge.
I know where you are standing.
I can still stand; my shell holds.
You will need more strength.
Insects; I smell them.
I could eat this, but not much.
Is that in your hand an insect?
I lower my head and look closely.

lines.zh: 我饿了，但没有到抢的地步
lines.en: I am hungry, but not enough to snatch.
Not enough; I am large.
It doesn't smell of insects.
Set it down and I will eat.
I eat insects, nothing else.
Step back; I eat slowly.
I push it toward the tree roots.
That bite was light; my mouth is small.

lines.zh: 你撞在我蓝甲上弹了回去
lines.en: You bounced off my blue plating.

lines.zh: 我的甲壳硬，撞上来你自己疼
lines.en: My shell is hard; the impact hurts you.
That made the tree ring.
I give half a step, and the ground dents.
I turn to let you pass.
Shell against shell, like a struck bell.
One side of my wings is caught.
I steady all my legs.

lines.zh: 地上的落叶被我们碾碎
lines.en: We crush the fallen leaves.
I dislike being shoved about.
Our kind meet through data.

lines.zh: 在同一个锚点待久了，就认得
lines.en: Staying at one anchor long enough, we come to know each other.

lines.zh: 我的蓝和它的红，都是甲
lines.en: My blue and its red are both shell.

lines.zh: 我们一起守着这片林子
lines.en: We keep this wood together.

lines.zh: 两只在一起，虫子不够分
lines.en: Two of us would thin the insects.
We rarely meet our own kind.
It is quieter; I am larger.

lines.zh: 同类之间，碰角就算打过招呼
lines.en: Among kin, a touch of horns is greeting enough.
Our shells sound different.
This ground holds both of us.
I take it with my mouthparts.
I lift it with both forelegs.
I nudge it with a foreleg.
I press it under a root.
My horn can lift things.

lines.zh: 它从我的口器上掉下去
lines.en: It slips from my mouthparts.
I am not nimble at carrying.
My mouthparts won't dent stone.
I shovel it out of the trees with my horn.
I swallowed it whole.
Something moves beyond the trees.
I raise my horn higher.

lines.zh: 这个距离，我的炮够得着
lines.en: From here, my cannon reaches.
I have judged it: ranged first.
It is smaller, but quick.
I make no sound; I charge.
The loudest insect ground is mine.

lines.zh: 我的甲壳站起来，挡住光
lines.en: I rise and block the light.
Its options are few.
I level my horn and take the first step.
I have this shot measured.
I bear down on it.

lines.zh: 我的腿压过落叶，不绕路
lines.en: My legs crush the leaves; I don't go around.
It circles a tree; I push straight through.

lines.zh: 我把它压在角和树之间
lines.en: I pin it between my horn and a trunk.

lines.zh: 距离还没到，我再近一点
lines.en: Not in range yet; a little closer.
It retreats; my legs follow.
I wait for it to expose its flank.
My wings begin to hum.
You are behind me; do not get too close.
It will not last long.
One more step is enough.
I stop and charge.
I lower my horn further.
I drive my horn in.

lines.zh: 这一下带着整个身体的重量
lines.en: That carried my full weight.

lines.zh: 我的前腿压下来，地都塌了
lines.en: My foreleg comes down and the earth gives.
It is shoved back several steps.
I pull back and recharge.
My shell slams in too.

lines.zh: 这一下偏了，树被我撞断
lines.en: That missed; I broke the tree instead.
I raise the horn once more.
It blocked, but I do not stop.
That was eight parts of my force.
My mouthparts open and close.
I return to position and brace.
I rise up in the woods.

lines.zh: 我的蓝甲先反光，然后是我
lines.en: My blue shell glints first, then the rest of me.

lines.zh: 这一片丛林有虫，我留下
lines.en: There are insects in this jungle; I stay.

lines.zh: 我落地时压塌了一片草
lines.en: My landing flattens a patch of grass.
My horn crosses the tree shadows first.
I take shape out of data.

lines.zh: 我站在锚点上，四周看了一圈
lines.en: I stand at my anchor and look around.

lines.zh: 林子里的虫声我听得清
lines.en: The insect noise is clear to me.

lines.zh: 我一片片壳都还带着光
lines.en: Every plate of me still carries a shine.
I fold my wings beneath my shell.

lines.zh: 这里的树很高，正好挡光
lines.en: The trees here are tall; good shade.

lines.zh: 我慢慢走向林子的中间
lines.en: I walk slowly toward the middle of the wood.

lines.zh: 火烤我的壳，我不喜欢这个温度
lines.en: Fire bakes my shell; I dislike this temperature.

lines.zh: 落地时我的蓝壳先着地
lines.en: My blue shell hits first.

lines.zh: 水灌进甲缝里，我使劲蹬
lines.en: Water fills my shell's seams; I kick hard.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我的壳掀开一角
lines.en: The blast lifts a corner of my shell.
Something drives into a seam of my shell.

lines.zh: 那股力压着我的角，抬不起来
lines.en: That force presses my horn down.
Few insects here; I stay hungry.

lines.zh: 雷打在我的角上，整只都麻
lines.en: Lightning hits my horn; I go numb.
Not even the woods remain below.
